subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly China Southern via Guangzhou to Shenyang, visit the Shenyang Imperial Palace, travel on to Jilin and then Harbin for the Ice-Snow World, Chateau Volga and the Siberian Tiger Park. You stay in 5-star hotels and get a free meal upgrade to Ice Palace hotpot and BBQ. This is a No Shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 29–Jan 4 2026 to Dec 29–Jan 4 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Shenyang Xiaonan Catholic Church: A Gothic-style Catholic church in downtown Shenyang, visited on a photo stop.
placeDesc.Zhongjie Walking Street: Shenyang's long-established pedestrian shopping street, offering free time for shopping.
placeDesc.Shenyang Imperial Palace: The former palace of early Qing emperors in Shenyang, a world heritage site.
placeDesc.Street of the Qing Dynasty: A pedestrian street in Shenyang built in Qing Dynasty style with shops and snacks.
placeDesc.Songjiang Middle Road: A riverside road in Jilin City known for its night view, seen from the bus.
placeDesc.Jilin Catholic Church: A Gothic-style Catholic church in Jilin City, visited on a photo stop.
placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, a popular promenade that freezes in winter.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park along the Songhua River in Harbin with walkways and old monuments.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's famous pedestrian street of European-style buildings, shops and cafes.
placeDesc.Flood Control Monument: A monument on the Songhua River bank in Harbin commemorating the city's 1957 flood fight.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square around Harbin's well-known Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: A huge winter park of illuminated ice and snow sculptures, one of Harbin's main attractions.
placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style manor park near Harbin with replica buildings, a church and winter activities.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian-style church replica at Volga Manor, popular for photos.
placeDesc.Vodka Fort: A themed building at Volga Manor where guests enjoy a small vodka with a snack.
placeDesc.Pushkin Exhibition Hall: An exhibition hall at Volga Manor dedicated to the Russian poet Alexander Pushkin.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A wildlife park in Harbin focused on Siberian tigers, viewed from a safe vehicle or walkways.
placeDesc.Harbin Grand Theater: A modern landmark theatre by the Songhua River designed to echo snow-covered hills, seen from the outside.
